title: The /events listing nested a full Event node per item with no location and no image, an invalid Event item in Search Console for every listed event

source.ref: found 2026-10-05 by the scan-seven SEO/GEO finders (26-agent fan-out), confirmed by hand against the tree

detail: FOUND 2026-10-05 (scan seven, two independent finders: seo-jsonld and seo-local). lib/jsonld.ts eventsListingSchema wrapped each ListItem around an Event node with name, startDate, url and eventStatus. Google requires location (and lists image) on an Event, and the listing deliberately cannot carry a location (ADR-186, the browse row holds the free-text venue), so every item was an invalid Event. CLOSED 2026-10-05: the listing is the SUMMARY form (ListItem with the canonical /events/<slug> url and the name), the shape eventListSchema and topicListSchema already used and the one Google documents for a page whose items have their own pages. The detail page still carries the full Event node. lib/jsonld.test.ts pins the shape.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const s=require("fs").readFileSync("lib/jsonld.ts","utf8");const a=s.indexOf("export function eventsListingSchema(");const b=s.indexOf("\n}\n",a);const body=s.slice(a,b);if(a<0||/@type.: .Event./.test(body)||!/url: abs\(`\/events\/\$\{e\.slug\}`\)/.test(body)){console.error("SCAN-664: the /events listing nests a full Event node per item with no location and no image, which Search Console reports as an invalid Event item, one per listed event; the summary form (ListItem url + name) is what a listing page should carry.");process.exit(1)}'
verify.note: Fails on main before this change; passes with it.
